verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has only a generic liveness claim ('Ensure a person is present and their face matches the image') and broad fraud marketing ('flag fraudulent ones'). It names no detection capability against AI-generated faces, deepfakes or camera/virtual-camera injection attacks, which is exactly the marketing-only level the story excludes. Defending against these attacks is a fair axis for an IDV product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the vendor documents specific defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes, and camera-injection attacks — named detection capabilities, not just a marketing mention of fraud
